Class EtherJsonUtil

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.persistence.EtherJsonUtil
public final class EtherJsonUtil extends Object

Centralized & Atomic JSON Serialization Utility

Provides robust, enterprise-grade JSON read/write operations for simulation saves, metadata descriptors, historical telemetry, and scenario presets.

Key Invariants:

  • Standardized Java 8 Date/Time support: Pre-configured with JavaTimeModule and WRITE_DATES_AS_TIMESTAMPS = false to prevent serialization crashes on LocalDateTime or Instant.
  • Atomic writes: All write operations stream content to an ephemeral temporary file before performing an atomic rename/move (StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE). This strictly guarantees that target files on disk (such as metadata.json or scenario.json) are never left corrupted, truncated, or half-written due to unexpected thread cancellations, exceptions, or process halts.
  • Resilient deserialization: Tolerates unknown properties without failing across schema versions.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2

    • writePrettyAtomic

      public static void writePrettyAtomic(Path targetPath, Object value) throws IOException
      Atomically writes an object to a destination path as formatted (pretty) JSON. Guarantees zero disk corruption by writing to a temporary file first and atomically renaming it.
      Parameters:
      targetPath - the target file path
      value - the object to serialize
      Throws:
      IOException - if disk write fails
